Container.Name: trackseerr
Container.Overview:
TrackSeerr is a self-hosted, multi-user music request, discovery, and library management suite combining an Overseerr-style frontend with an Arr-style media management and acquisition backend for Plex Media Server and Plexamp.
Key Capabilities: - Music Discovery & Audio Previews: Zero-key discovery of trending charts, new releases, and deep search via public Apple Music and Deezer APIs with 30-second audio previews. - Multi-User Request Engine: Plex Home user integration, per-user request quotas, and administrative approval queues. - Dual Acquisition Engine: Fulfill requests using your existing Lidarr server via batched trickle automation, or use native acquisition drivers (slskd / Soulseek P2P for single-track and album surgical matching, SABnzbd for Usenet, qBittorrent for torrents, Torznab/Newznab indexers). - Real-Time Activity Queue: Live transfer progress, speed monitoring, cancellation, and retry controls. - Arr-Grade Media Management: Mutagen audio inspection, token template naming engine ({Artist Name}/{Album Title} ({Release Year})/{track:00} - {Track Title}), collision protection, and automated Plex library refresh pings. - Playlist Synchronization: Import and synchronize Spotify and Deezer playlists directly into personal Plexamp profiles with keyless scraping and 1-click browser bookmarklets.
Note: Lidarr automation, Plex settings, download clients, indexers, media management paths, and quotas are configured dynamically in the WebUI Settings.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Web Dashboard and REST API port. Accessible in your browser.

Config.Name: AppData Storage
Config.Description: Persistent configuration directory for the SQLite database, sessions, and logs.

Config.Name: Data Storage (TRaSH Guides)
Config.Description: Unified host data share containing both library (/data/media/music) and download staging (/data/downloads) on a single filesystem to enable instant atomic moves and hardlinks.

Config.Name: Execution Role
Config.Description: Container execution role: 'all-in-one' (default, runs web gateway and acquisition worker) or 'gateway'/'core' for two-tier DMZ architectures.

Config.Name: Plex Server URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Plex Media Server, using your server's LAN IP and port 32400. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use localhost on bridge networking.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex Admin X-Plex-Token. Optional initially if using the Web Dashboard Plex OAuth PIN login, but required for background daemon sync.

Config.Name: Plex Music Library Section
Config.Description: Name of your Plex music library section.

Config.Name: Plex Machine Identifier
Config.Description: Plex server machine identifier for multi-user access pinning. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Plex SSL Verification
Config.Description: Set to 0 if your Plex Media Server uses a self-signed certificate without valid chain.

Config.Name: Feed Access Token
Config.Description: Optional: Secret token to protect RSS feeds, plain text lists, and webhook endpoints if exposed to untrusted networks.

Config.Name: Sync Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Duration in seconds between automated background sync cycles (default 14400 = 4 hours).

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Standard umask permissions for created files.
